rationale: The workflow contains two matrix jobs (build-ksud-from-source and build-from-source) with fail-fast: false. Evidence from synthetic experiments (experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242 and experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997) shows that setting fail-fast: true can reduce runtime in controlled scenarios. However, the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern contraindicates use when 'Every matrix outcome is required' — here each matrix cell produces independent manager APKs for distinct root flavors, and the user likely expects all selected flavors to be built even if one fails. The workflow also already specifies custom timeouts (40 and 90 minutes) on those jobs; the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) adds a timeout where none existed, but the pattern requires representative successful-duration history to set a tighter bound, which is not available. Caching patterns (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) are already partially addressed via gradle/actions/setup-gradle and Swatinem/rust-cache. No other pattern matches the workflow's structure without violating contraindications or lacking prerequisites. Therefore, no supported optimization can be safely applied.
